# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.19

This staging candidate adds a portable, guided Windows installer for a fresh
RX Tracker NEXT server. Existing NEXT servers continue to update through
Project Control option 8 and option 15.

## What is new

- Adds `RX-Tracker-NEXT-New-Server-4.0.0-next.19.zip`.
- Creates a separately named fresh PostgreSQL database through all audited
  migrations and reference-data seeds.
- Creates the first master Administrator explicitly.
- Creates and verifies a restricted PostgreSQL runtime role.
- Generates a destination-specific `.env`, NSSM service configuration,
  non-secret installation receipt, and exact-version health check.
- Adds a conservative 3.3.x retirement checklist with a verified rollback
  archive and a separate approval-gated deletion phase.

## Security

- The ZIP contains no reusable `.env`, passwords, tokens, patient data, SIP
  credentials, or backups.
- JWT, SIP encryption, relay, runtime database, and phone-account PIN values
  are generated independently on the destination server.
- The PostgreSQL maintenance password is held only in the installer process
  and is not written to the final `.env`.
- The first Administrator password must contain at least 12 characters.
- The installed `.env` is restricted to Local System and local Administrators.

## Validation

- PowerShell parsing and installer safety/packaging regressions passed.
- A disposable PostgreSQL installation passed all 35 migrations, generated
  runtime configuration, restricted-role verification, exact-version health,
  and first master-administrator login.
- The disposable server was stopped and its test database and roles were
  removed after validation.

No migration or data reset is performed on an existing NEXT installation.
RX Softphone remains version 0.6.0.
